what_it_is:
The iFuse 3D by SI-Bone is a 3D printed titanium porous implant for use in the minimally invasive surgical approach for treatment of SI Joint dysfunction. The graft is triangular shaped which provides more resistance to rotation than traditional screws.

Features:
- 3D printed triangular titanium material
- Porous for increased bony ingrowth
- Triangular shaped to resist rotation
- Self harvesting of autograft with insertion
- Size: 11.35mm
- Length options: 35-90mm
indications: Minimally invasive surgical fusion of the sacroiliac (SI) joint in patients who have failed non-surgical treatment.
use_notes: Lateral transiliac approach. 5-year prospective multicenter trial (103 patients/12 sites): 88% patient satisfaction, 87% bridging bone within SI joint, 40% decrease in opioid use, 54-point VAS improvement, 25-point ODI improvement.
